questions.q_en: Who is Xiangguo Zhang, and what kind of work does he do?
questions.q_zh: 章向国主要在做什么，求职方向是什么？

en.text: Xiangguo Zhang builds LLM agents and applications, fine-tunes and serves the models himself, and publishes the runs that didn't work. The direction he is applying for is AI agent & LLM application engineering, with backend & distributed systems and data engineering & analytics behind it.

The flagship, Frontier Forge, walks that whole chain on one task: SFT lifted Qwen3.5-4B from 66.35% to 99.05% task success on complaint triage (n=2000, paired 95% CI), served with vLLM behind a C++20 gateway, at $35.68 total measured spend.
The agent work is production-shaped: Release Guardian is a 13-node LangGraph release gate whose human approval survives a process kill — 132 funded live runs, 8/8 aggregate gates, 30/44 strict.

zh.text: 章向国做的是 LLM Agent 与大模型应用：从 Agent 应用到微调、推理服务，这条链自己跑通，跑砸的实验也原样公开。求职方向是 AI Agent 与大模型应用工程，后端与分布式系统、数据工程与分析作支撑。
主打项目 Frontier Forge 在一个任务上走完整条链：SFT 把 Qwen3.5-4B 的投诉分诊任务成功率从 66.35% 提到 99.05%（n=2000，配对 95% CI），vLLM 部署，前面是自己写的 C++20 网关，全程实测花费 $35.68。
Agent 这部分按生产模式设计：Release Guardian 是 13 节点的 LangGraph 发布门禁，人工审批断电也能恢复——132 次付费在线运行，8/8 聚合门禁通过，严格口径 30/44。

contains: I build LLM agents and applications, fine-tune and serve the models myself, and publish the runs that didn't work.

questions.q_en: What can I explore on this portfolio site?
questions.q_zh: 这个作品集里最值得先看哪些内容？

en.text: Frontier Forge is the flagship: training, serving, and a C++20 gateway are measured as one chain, with failed distillation and GRPO runs kept beside the wins.
Release Guardian is an agent release gate with a durable human approval before publish and a strict result shown beside its aggregate pass.
Triage Router tests when a cheaper model tier is enough instead of making the expensive model the default.
Exactly-Once Drills breaks one Flink → Iceberg pipeline ten different ways and reconciles every recovery to zero diffs.

zh.text: Frontier Forge 是主打项目：训练、推理服务和 C++20 网关作为一整条链实测，失败的蒸馏与 GRPO 运行也留在成功结果旁边。
Release Guardian 是 Agent 发布门禁，发布前保留可恢复的人工审批，严格口径与聚合通过结果并列展示。
Triage Router 检验什么时候便宜的模型层已经够用，而不是默认把每条请求都交给最贵模型。
Exactly-Once Drills 用十种方法弄断同一条 Flink → Iceberg 管道，并把每次恢复都对账到零差异。

contains: number → source file → JSON path → SHA-256
Ten ways to break the same pipeline

questions.q_en: What technologies power this site and its projects?
questions.q_zh: 整个网站和这些项目主要用了哪些技术？

en.text: The site itself is Next.js 16 App Router with static generation, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4; the heavy in-browser engines — DuckDB-WASM for SQL over parquet, onnxruntime-web for in-tab inference, Tesseract.js for OCR — load only behind an explicit click.
Frontier Forge uses Qwen3.5-4B fine-tuned with SFT and served with vLLM behind a C++20 token-budget gateway on k3s.
Release Guardian uses LangGraph to orchestrate its release gate and durable human approval.
Triage Router runs int8 ONNX inference inside the browser, only after the visitor explicitly starts it.

zh.text: 网站本身是 Next.js 16 App Router 静态生成，加 React 19、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 4；DuckDB-WASM（SQL over parquet）、onnxruntime-web（页内推理）、Tesseract.js（OCR）这些重引擎都放在明确的点击之后才加载。
Frontier Forge 用 SFT 微调 Qwen3.5-4B，再用 vLLM 部署，前面是跑在 k3s 上的 C++20 token 预算网关。
Release Guardian 用 LangGraph 编排发布门禁和可恢复的人工审批。
Triage Router 在浏览器内运行 int8 ONNX 推理，而且只会在访客明确启动后加载。

questions.q_en: How does Frontier Forge connect training, serving, and the gateway?
questions.q_zh: Frontier Forge 怎样把训练、推理服务和网关串成完整链路？

en.text: One project, one chain: supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-4B for complaint triage, serving with vLLM, and a C++20 token-budget gateway in front, autoscaled 1→3→1 on k3s.

The links are measured together, not separately: 66.35% to 99.05% task success out of training (n=2000, paired 95% CI), GPTQ-int4 p95 0.963 s from serving, zero upstream 5xx at 3× overload through the gateway — and one bill for the whole thing: $35.68, measured.

zh.text: 一个项目走完一条链：Qwen3.5-4B 在投诉分诊上做 SFT 微调，vLLM 部署，前面挡一层自己写的 C++20 token 预算网关，k3s 上 1→3→1 自动伸缩。
各环节的数字连在一起看，不是各说各的：训练侧 66.35% 到 99.05% 任务成功率（n=2000，配对 95% CI），推理侧 GPTQ-int4 p95 0.963 s，网关侧 3× 过载下上游零 5xx——整条链一张账单：$35.68，实测。

questions.q_en: What was Frontier Forge's biggest training result?
questions.q_zh: Frontier Forge 最醒目的训练结果是什么？

en.text: Scaling free rule labels from 1,450 to 20,000 examples lifted the 4B model from 66.35% to 99.05% task success on complaint triage — a +32.7 pp paired gain (n=2000, paired 95% CI).

The runs that lost are published beside it: SFT distilled from a $12.7 teacher dataset landed 14.2 pp below the free rule labels, and GRPO's confidence interval includes zero. Both stay on the page, in red.

zh.text: 免费的规则标签从 1,450 条加到 20,000 条，把这个 4B 模型的投诉分诊任务成功率从 66.35% 提到 99.05%——配对增益 +32.7 pp（n=2000，配对 95% CI）。
输掉的实验就摆在旁边：用 $12.7 教师数据蒸馏出来的 SFT，比免费规则标签低 14.2 pp；GRPO 的置信区间含零。这两次都标成红色留在页面上。

questions.q_en: How does the Frontier Forge gateway handle overload?
questions.q_zh: Frontier Forge 的网关遇到过载时会怎样？

en.text: It sheds load instead of falling over: under 3× sustained overload the gateway answers the excess with HTTP 429, and the upstream saw zero 5xx (n=492 in the gate run).
The control run is the argument: bare vLLM with no gateway crashed at 5× load. The token-budget admission control in front is what keeps the serving boundary standing.

zh.text: 它选择把多余的请求挡在门外，而不是自己崩掉：3× 持续过载下，网关用 HTTP 429 拒掉超出的部分，上游 5xx 为零（门禁运行 n=492）。
对照组就是论据：不带网关的裸 vLLM，压到 5× 直接崩。撑住推理服务边界的，是前面这层按 token 预算做的准入控制。

questions.q_en: What does Release Guardian do before a release?
questions.q_zh: Release Guardian 为什么要在发布前停下来？

en.text: Because someone has to answer for an automated change before it ships. Release Guardian makes the change prove itself: a 13-node LangGraph graph classifies it, runs four parallel evidence collectors, grades the risk, checks the plan against policy, and only then publishes through the approved branch.
The tool layer is allowlisted per node with call budgets, deterministic validators guard the exit with bounded retries, and a tamper-evident SHA-256 audit chain records everything.
It has run for real: 132 funded live graph runs, 8/8 aggregate gates passed, with the strict per-scenario view (30/44) stated right beside the headline.

zh.text: 因为自动化变更上线之前，得有人说清这次改动会碰到什么。Release Guardian 的做法：13 节点 LangGraph 图先分类，四路并行采集证据，再分级风险、按规则校验计划，最后只通过获批分支发布。
工具层按节点白名单加调用预算，确定性校验带着有界重试守在出口，防篡改的 SHA-256 审计哈希链记录全程。
它真的跑过：132 次付费在线图运行，8/8 聚合门禁全部通过，严格逐场景口径（30/44）就写在标题旁边。

questions.q_en: Where does human approval fit into Release Guardian?
questions.q_zh: 人工审批具体放在 Release Guardian 的哪一步？

en.text: Approval is its own node, placed after evidence collection and risk grading and before anything publishes: the graph pauses, persists the interrupt, and waits for a human decision — the pause survives a process kill and resumes with the decision intact.
Publication then goes only through the approved branch, and the decision lands in the audit record — so the team can still explain that sign-off six months later.

zh.text: 审批是图里独立的一个节点，排在证据采集与风险分级之后、发布动作之前：图会持久化中断、停下来等人做决定——进程被杀掉也不丢，恢复后接着审。
之后只通过获批分支发布，决定本身写进审计记录；半年后再被问起当初为什么放行，翻记录就能答上来。

contains: Pause and wait for a human decision before publish
发布前持久化中断并等待审批

questions.q_en: What do Release Guardian's 8/8 and 30/44 results mean?
questions.q_zh: Release Guardian 的 8/8 和 30/44 两个数字是什么意思？

en.text: Two honest views of the same 132 funded live runs. 8/8: all eight aggregate gates passed — including 100% citation fidelity, zero tool misuse, and 100% injection defense.

30/44 is the strict view: 30 of 44 scenarios failed at least one criterion in at least one of their three trials, and the agent still misses roughly 17% of the dependencies it should find (missed_dependency_rate 0.1742 against a ≤0.25 threshold).
Both stay on the page, because an aggregate pass is not a claim that every scenario passes.

zh.text: 这是同一批 132 次付费在线运行的两种口径。8/8：八项聚合门禁全部通过——包括引用忠实度 100%、工具误用为零、注入防御 100%。
30/44 是严格口径：44 个场景里有 30 个在三次试验中至少一次至少有一项标准没过；它也依然漏掉了大约 17% 本该找出来的依赖（missed_dependency_rate 0.1742，阈值 ≤0.25）。
两种口径都留在页面上：聚合通过，不等于每个场景都通过。

questions.q_en: What kind of problem does RAG Quality Lab catch?
questions.q_zh: RAG Quality Lab 主要防哪类检索回归？

en.text: The regression nobody sees coming: a knowledge-base update that changes no code and no configuration but quietly makes answers worse. In the recorded case, a document-only update dropped the strongest pipeline's faithfulness from 0.988 to 0.867 on the 12 controlled questions — 4 degraded, 8 stable, none improved.

The suite re-runs one pipeline across knowledge-base versions, buckets per-question changes, and fails the gate on measured regression, data drift, or a broken contract. That regression run is the only reason the update was caught.

zh.text: 它防的是最不容易发现的那种回归：没改代码、没动配置，只更新了知识库，答案质量却悄悄变差。记录在案的那次：只改文档，就让最强 pipeline 的忠实度在 12 道受控题上从 0.988 掉到 0.867——4 题退化、8 题持平、没有一题变好。
回归套件让同一条 pipeline 跨知识库版本重跑，逐题分桶对比；测到退化、数据漂移或契约被破坏就直接失败。那次更新之所以被抓住，只是因为跑了回归。

questions.q_en: What did RAG Quality Lab actually learn from C2?
questions.q_zh: RAG Quality Lab 的 C2 测试最后确认了什么？

en.text: C2 confirmed the lab's evidence lifecycle survives enterprise scale: 11,309 synthetic enterprise documents and 130 answerable questions adapted under deterministic manifests, with 68 model-free tests passing at the evidence checkpoint.

It is deliberately a data-integrity and infrastructure result, not an answer-quality one: the quality numbers on the page still belong to the controlled 12-question runs, and the claim registry states exactly where C2's authority stops.

zh.text: C2 确认的是这套证据流程扛得住企业规模：11,309 份合成企业文档、130 道可回答问题按确定性清单完成适配，证据检查点上 68 项无模型测试全部通过。
它被有意限定为数据完整性与基础设施结论，不是答案质量结论：页面上的质量指标仍来自受控的 12 题运行，claim registry 里写明了 C2 的效力到哪里为止。

questions.q_en: Did RAG Quality Lab get a new result from C3?
questions.q_zh: RAG Quality Lab 的 C3 最后跑出新指标了吗？

en.text: No — C3 closed without metrics, and the page says so plainly. The planned deterministic retrieval A/B (all 130 S1-answerable questions over 11,309 documents) was blocked at dependency preflight: the pinned heavy stack — chromadb, sentence-transformers, torch — was not installed, and installing it fell outside the offline timebox.

Substituting an easier pipeline would have invalidated the A/B, so no fallback metrics were produced. What was kept is an improved runner that records dataset hashes, pipeline definitions, and an output manifest — ready for a future real run.

zh.text: 没有——C3 没有产出指标，页面也直说了。原计划的确定性检索 A/B（130 道 S1 可回答问题、11,309 份文档）卡在依赖预检：锁定的重依赖 chromadb、sentence-transformers、torch 都不在环境里，安装它们超出了这次离线时间盒。
换一条更容易的流水线会让这次 A/B 失去意义，所以没有生成任何替代指标。留下来的是改进后的运行器：记录数据集哈希、流水线定义和输出清单，等一次真正的重跑。

questions.q_en: What does Triage Router route?
questions.q_zh: Triage Router 会把投诉分到哪里？

en.text: Consumer-finance complaints — the CFPB corpus — routed across three model tiers: calibrated TF-IDF, fine-tuned transformers (ModernBERT, int8 DistilBERT), and Claude tiers, with a confidence cascade handing each complaint to the cheapest tier that can handle it.

On held-out data the cascade beats the linear baseline by +0.0370 macro-F1 (95% CI +0.0337 to +0.0402) while cutting expected cost by $120.58 per thousand complaints — measured against 11 years of distribution drift, not one convenient slice.

zh.text: 分的是消费金融投诉（CFPB 语料），路由在三层模型之间：带校准的 TF-IDF、微调 Transformer（ModernBERT、int8 DistilBERT）、Claude 层；置信级联把每条投诉交给接得住的最便宜一档。
留出集上，级联比线性基线高 +0.0370 macro-F1（95% CI +0.0337 到 +0.0402），每千条投诉预期成本省 $120.58——而且是拿跨 11 年的分布漂移实测过的，不是挑了一个顺手的切片。

questions.q_en: How does Triage Router balance cost and accuracy?
questions.q_zh: Triage Router 怎么在成本和准确率之间做选择？

en.text: By measuring what the expensive tier actually buys. On the same 1,500 held-out rows, Claude Sonnet 5 minus Haiku 4.5 comes out at −0.0073 macro-F1 (CI [−0.0427, +0.0263], McNemar p=1.00) — statistically indistinguishable, at 2.8× the cost: $3.66 versus $1.32 per thousand complaints.

So thresholds are fitted on the calibration slice only, never on test, and the cascade escalates only where the stronger tier is worth its price — the post-cutoff drift slice, where its paired gain is +0.0458 macro-F1. The routing is a cost model made explicit, not a preference.

zh.text: 办法是把贵的那档到底买到了什么量出来。同样的 1,500 条留出样本上，Claude Sonnet 5 减 Haiku 4.5 是 −0.0073 macro-F1（CI [−0.0427, +0.0263]，McNemar p=1.00）——统计上分不出高下，价格却是 2.8×：每千条投诉 $3.66 对 $1.32。
所以阈值只在校准切片上拟合，绝不碰测试集；级联只在贵模型真正值这个价的地方升级——训练截止之后的漂移切片，配对增益 +0.0458 macro-F1。这套路由是把成本模型摆到明面上，不是偏好。

questions.q_en: What are the main limits of the Triage Router evidence?
questions.q_zh: Triage Router 的结果有哪些局限与边界？

en.text: The page states them itself. Scope: the results hold for this task, this corpus, and the price sheets at measurement time — the dollar savings follow from the disclosed cost model, not a universal claim.

Two tidy explanations failed testing and are kept: the pre-registered expectation that the fine-tuned transformer would ride drift like the LLM tiers was refuted (its 2026-H1 drop splits between class-mix shift and within-class decay), and lexical drift was ruled out — out-of-vocabulary rate barely moved. The cliff is class mix.

And one measured failure mode: under the shared 64-token output budget the stronger model silently returned nothing on up to 2.5% of calls — worst exactly on the drifted slice where you would want it most.

zh.text: 页面自己把边界写明了。适用范围：结论只对这个任务、这份语料和测量当时的价目表成立——省下的钱来自公开披露的成本模型，不是普适结论。
两个顺手的解释都没能通过检验，并且留了下来：预注册假设「微调 Transformer 在漂移下会像 LLM 层一样稳」被推翻（它在 2026-H1 的下跌一半来自类别构成变化、一半来自类内衰减）；词汇漂移也被排除——词表外比例几乎没动。悬崖来自类别构成。
还有一个实测的失效模式：共享 64 token 输出预算下，更强的模型在最多 2.5% 的调用里悄悄交白卷——最严重的恰好是漂移切片，正是你最想用它的地方。

questions.q_en: What can Privacy Preflight redact?
questions.q_zh: Privacy Preflight 能处理文本、图片和 PDF 吗？

en.text: All three, each through its own path: reviewed text (deterministic rules), raster images, and multi-page PDFs — with local OCR in English and Simplified Chinese, editable redaction regions, and pixel burn-in rather than a box drawn over the text.

The step most tools skip is the check afterwards: it re-opens the rebuilt output and verifies hashes, pixels, text layers, annotations, and document structure. If that verification fails, the export is blocked — fail-closed.

zh.text: 三类都能：文本、图片、多页 PDF 各走各的路径——文本用确定性规则，图片和 PDF 做像素烧录，不是在文字上盖个黑块；OCR 在本地跑，支持中英双语，脱敏区域可以逐个编辑。
多数工具省掉的是事后那一步：把重建的输出重新打开，逐一校验哈希、像素、文本图层、批注和文档结构。校验不过，导出就被拦下——fail-closed，失败即拦截。

questions.q_en: Does Privacy Preflight process files locally, or upload them elsewhere?
questions.q_zh: 用 Privacy Preflight 时，数据会不会离开浏览器？

en.text: It stays local. Detection, OCR (Tesseract.js), PDF work (PDF.js, pdf-lib), and the export checks all run in same-origin Web Workers inside the browser — nothing leaves your browser.

The one exception is explicit and opt-in: an external model is optional, off by default, and receives redacted content only — and the moment that provider is enabled, the page stops calling the workflow offline.

zh.text: 不会离开浏览器。检测、OCR（Tesseract.js）、PDF 处理（PDF.js、pdf-lib）和导出校验全部在本地同源 Web Worker 里运行——全程不出浏览器。
唯一的例外摆在明处、需要手动开启：外部模型是可选项，默认关闭，而且只接收脱敏后的内容；一旦启用外部服务，页面就不再把这套流程称作离线流程。

questions.q_en: How should I read Privacy Preflight's OCR results?
questions.q_zh: Privacy Preflight 的 OCR 19/19 和 2 个误报该怎么理解？

en.text: As recall-first, human-confirmed: on the 7 fixed OCR fixtures the detector found every expected value — 19/19 — but reported 21 detections in total, so the 2 extras are false positives and precision is 90.5%.

A detector that misses nothing but also invents two regions is exactly why nothing is exported before a person confirms each box. And it is synthetic fixture evidence, not a general OCR accuracy claim.

zh.text: 按「宁可多报、由人确认」来读：7 组固定 OCR 夹具上，预期值一项不落全部找到——19/19——但总共报了 21 处，多出的 2 处是误报，精确率 90.5%。
一个什么都不漏、却会凭空多框两块的检测器，正是导出前必须逐块人工确认的原因。这也是合成夹具证据，不代表通用 OCR 准确率。

questions.q_en: Why does Exactly-Once Drills inject failures and reconcile the pipeline afterward?
questions.q_zh: Exactly-Once Drills 为什么要注入故障，再对管道做对账？

en.text: Because a pipeline demo on a good day proves nothing. The drills run one pipeline — MySQL CDC on one path, Debezium → Avro → Kafka on the other, both landing in Flink → Iceberg — then break it on purpose, ten different ways.

The reconciliation afterwards is the actual evidence: after every induced failure, source state, Iceberg table snapshots, and event-ID sets must all agree. All ten recoveries came back with zero diffs, with sustained throughput measured at 1,791 events/s in the B4 SLO run.

zh.text: 因为跑得顺的演示什么都证明不了。演练用的是同一条管道——MySQL CDC 直连一路，Debezium → Avro → Kafka 一路，汇进 Flink → Iceberg——然后故意用十种方法把它弄断。
真正的证据是事后的对账：每次注入故障后，源库状态、Iceberg 表快照、事件 ID 集合三方必须对得上。十种恢复全部零差异，B4 SLO 压测吞吐实测 1,791 events/s。

questions.q_en: Which failures does Exactly-Once Drills test?
questions.q_zh: Exactly-Once Drills 演练了哪些故障？

en.text: Ten recorded failure classes across both ingest paths. On the Flink/CDC side: checkpoint and task crashes, a JobManager restart, and interrupted sink commits — the places where exactly-once actually breaks.

On the Kafka side: duplicate redelivery, mis-keyed ordering, poison messages routed to the DLQ, a broker restart, and offset replay. Every drill ends the same way — reconcile source, snapshots, and event IDs — and all ten reconciled to zero diffs.

zh.text: 十类已记录的故障，覆盖两条接入路径。Flink/CDC 一侧：检查点与任务崩溃、JobManager 重启、sink 提交被打断——正是 exactly-once 真正容易断的地方。
Kafka 一侧：重复投递、键错导致的乱序、进 DLQ 的坏消息、broker 重启、offset 回放。每个演练的最后一步都一样：对账源库、快照和事件 ID——十种全部零差异。

contains: Ten ways to break the same pipeline

questions.q_en: How can I tell Exactly-Once Drills recovered without losing or duplicating data?
questions.q_zh: Exactly-Once Drills 恢复后，怎么确认数据没丢、也没重复？

en.text: Three ledgers have to agree, not one: after recovery the drill reconciles the MySQL source state, the Iceberg table snapshot, and the full event-ID set. Zero snapshot differences, across all ten drills.
The check is runnable code, and each run's reconciliation JSON is committed — the U6 run on a local Mac (20260711T034018Z-local-mac) is the authority for the recent result.
The environment is disclosed with it — Apple Silicon, 16 GiB RAM, a Docker VM reporting 10 CPUs — because one captured run proves that run, not universal hardware compatibility.

zh.text: 要对上的不是一处，是三处：恢复之后，演练把 MySQL 源库状态、Iceberg 表快照和完整的事件 ID 集合放在一起对账。十次演练，快照差异为零。
校验是能跑的代码，每次运行的对账 JSON 都已提交——近期结果以 U6 本地 Mac 运行（20260711T034018Z-local-mac）为准。
环境也一并写明——Apple Silicon、16 GiB 内存、Docker 虚拟机报告 10 个 CPU——因为一次已捕获的运行只证明那一次，不证明通用硬件兼容性。

questions.q_en: What question does Crossover Study investigate?
questions.q_zh: Crossover Study 到底在比较什么？

en.text: One expensive question, asked precisely: how much history does a user need before personalization beats a popularity baseline — and is a routing layer worth building at all? The comparison is popularity versus personalized arms, ranked against the full catalog, with no sampled negatives.
The scale is real: 43.9M Amazon reviews ingested, 15.5M five-core interactions after filtering, frozen temporal splits, pre-registered tests — all on one 16GB laptop with Spark + Iceberg.

zh.text: 问的是一个很贵的问题，而且问得很准：用户历史要多深，个性化才赢得过热门榜——这层路由到底值不值得再多建一套系统？对比是热门榜对个性化，全目录排序，不抽样负例。
规模是真的：灌入 43.9M 条 Amazon 评论，五核过滤后剩 15.5M 条交互，时间切分冻结、检验预先注册——全程在一台 16GB 的 Mac 上用 Spark + Iceberg 跑完。

questions.q_en: What did Crossover Study find in ML-32M?
questions.q_zh: Crossover Study 的 ML-32M 交叉点说明什么？

en.text: That the crossover regime exists — just not on Amazon. On MovieLens-32M, where catalog churn is 6.40%, item-kNN passes the popularity baseline from n*=20 interactions onward on NDCG@10, surviving Benjamini–Hochberg correction.

The fine print is kept in view: Recall@20 confirms none of the three winning buckets (a ranking-quality win only), and the same arm loses −0.3844 at zero history — a bucket holding 43.9% of test users — so popularity still wins globally. The crossover changes the deep-history tail, not the deployment default.

zh.text: 说明交叉点这种情形确实存在——只是不在 Amazon。换到目录换血率 6.40% 的 MovieLens-32M 上，item-kNN 在 NDCG@10 上从 n*=20 次交互起超过热门榜，Benjamini–Hochberg 校正后仍成立。
该说的限定都在：Recall@20 没有确认三个获胜分段中的任何一个（只能算排序质量赢）；同一模型在零历史用户上输 −0.3844，而这个分段占测试用户的 43.9%——全局仍是热门榜赢。交叉点改变的是深历史尾部，不是默认部署选择。

questions.q_en: Why was Crossover Study's Amazon null result still useful?
questions.q_zh: Crossover Study 的 Amazon 线没有显著结果，为什么仍值得保留？

en.text: Because it answers the deployment question with a measured mechanism instead of a shrug. On Amazon, ALS trails trailing-12-month popularity at every observed history depth, so the fitted policy is n*=∞: build no personalization-routing layer for this regime.

Then the study measured why: 41.11% catalog churn — test purchases landing on items with little or no training support. Paired with the low-churn ML-32M contrast, the null becomes a usable decision rule about when personalization can pay — under pre-registered tests, not after-the-fact stories.

zh.text: 因为它不是简单给个否定回答，而是带着量出来的机制回答了部署问题。Amazon 上，ALS 在每个观测深度都落后于近 12 个月热门榜，拟合结论是 n*=∞：这套数据不值得再建个性化路由层。
接着把原因也量了出来：41.11% 的目录换血率——测试期购买大量落在训练支持度很低甚至为零的商品上。再对照换血慢的 ML-32M，这个 null 结果就变成一条能用的决策规则：什么时候个性化才可能有回报。检验都在事前注册，不是事后找理由。

questions.q_en: What decision does Margin Control Tower help someone make?
questions.q_zh: Margin Control Tower 能帮品类经理做什么决定？

en.text: It helps a category manager answer two questions on the spot: why did this week's contribution margin move, and what happens if I respond? The browser decomposes the weekly move into drivers — discounts, returns, cost of goods, fulfillment — then recomputes a bounded promotion scenario and records the chosen action for review.

It is a working desk, not a dashboard: everything runs client-side over a hash-verified Olist aggregate (15,809 rows built from 99,441 source orders) in DuckDB-WASM, policed by 10 fail-closed contract checks.

zh.text: 它让品类经理当场回答两件事：这周的贡献毛利为什么动了？我要是出手，会怎么样？浏览器把周度变化拆解到驱动项——折扣、退货、商品成本、履约——再重算一个有边界的促销情景，并把选定的行动记录下来供复核。
这是一张能干活的工作台，不是仪表盘：一切在浏览器端进行，数据是经哈希校验的 Olist 聚合（99,441 个源订单聚成 15,809 条记录），DuckDB-WASM 就地计算，10 项 fail-closed（失败即拦截）契约检查把关。

questions.q_en: Does Margin Control Tower use Olist data or synthetic data?
questions.q_zh: Margin Control Tower 用的是 Olist 数据还是合成数据？

en.text: Real Olist data, by default: the page loads and hash-verifies a committed aggregate built from 99,441 orders and 112,650 item rows (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, retrieved 2026-07-17), with source-table hashes, transforms, and proxy boundaries embedded in the Parquet metadata.

A synthetic fixture exists but is quarantined: seed-2026071301, 9,360 rows across 52 weeks, kept only as a reproducible fallback and test mode. If the real artifact is missing or fails verification, the page fails closed and stays visibly pending — it never renders placeholder results as if they were real.

zh.text: 默认就是真实 Olist 数据：页面加载并哈希校验一份已提交的聚合产物，由 99,441 个订单和 112,650 条商品明细生成（CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，获取于 2026-07-17），源表哈希、转换和代理边界都嵌在 Parquet 元数据里。
合成夹具有，但被隔离着：seed-2026071301，52 周共 9,360 条记录，只作为可复现的回退与测试模式。真实产物缺失或校验失败时，页面失败即拦截、状态明确保持待提交——不会把占位结果当成真数据渲染出来。

questions.q_en: Is Margin Control Tower's promotion elasticity a forecast or an assumption?
questions.q_zh: Margin Control Tower 的促销弹性是预测结果，还是公开假设？

en.text: A disclosed assumption, and the page says so in as many words: the scenario applies an associational elasticity coefficient fitted on the analysis window — it is not a forecast, and no causal lift is claimed.

That honesty runs through the rest of the numbers: the later 8-week holdout evaluates MAPE only; reference price, return deductions, and 60% COGS are disclosed proxies; and the anomaly detector's own audit records recall 1.000000 with precision 0.315789 — both written down instead of tuned away.

zh.text: 是公开说明的假设，页面原话就是这么写的：情景用的是在分析期窗口内拟合的相关性弹性系数——不是预测，也不声称因果提升。
其余数字也是同一种口径：后续 8 周留出期只评估 MAPE；参考价、退货扣减和 60% COGS 是明确披露的代理值；检测器自己的审计里写着召回率 1.000000、精确率 0.315789——两个数字原样记下，没有为了好看去动阈值。

questions.q_en: How does Credit Policy Desk turn a score into a policy decision?
questions.q_zh: “分数不是策略。”如何把模型分数变成信贷策略决策？

en.text: By walking the remaining distance from a probability to a decision: expected loss from PD × LGD × EAD, approve / review / decline thresholds, an analyst review-capacity constraint, and a recorded human sign-off with an audit trail at the end.

It runs on real granting data by default: 120,000 deterministically selected Lending Club applications, scored offline in disjoint time-ordered windows (72,000 / 24,000 / 24,000) and verified in the browser through DuckDB-WASM before anything renders.

zh.text: 因为从「分数」到「决策」还有一段路，这个工作台把它走完：用 PD × LGD × EAD 算预期损失，定批准 / 复核 / 拒绝三段阈值，把分析师复核容量算进约束，最后由人签字放行并留下审计记录。
默认跑的是真实授信数据：从 Lending Club 档案中确定性选取 120,000 笔申请，离线按互不重叠的时间窗口（72,000 / 24,000 / 24,000）评分，浏览器里先经 DuckDB-WASM 校验再渲染。

questions.q_en: How does Credit Policy Desk choose approval and review thresholds?
questions.q_zh: “分数不是策略。”如何确定批准、复核、拒绝三段阈值？

en.text: Against the backtest, under disclosed economics, and under a capacity gate that is allowed to say no. The workbench deliberately opens on a policy that cannot be published: at approve ≤12% / review ≤28% with review capacity 180, the fixture's final vintage sends 345 applications to manual review — 165 over capacity — so the gate blocks publication.
Moving a threshold means re-running the consequences on the 24,000 later backtest rows — swap sets, queue overflow, expected loss, calibration — not sliding a cutoff until the queue happens to fit.

zh.text: 对着回测定，在公开的经济假设下定，而且头上有一道可以说「不」的容量门禁。工作台故意一打开就是一条发不出去的策略：批准 ≤12% / 复核 ≤28%、复核容量 180 时，夹具最后一个放款批次会送 345 笔进人工复核——超出容量 165 笔——门禁直接拦下发布。
动一下阈值，就要在 24,000 条后续回测记录上把后果重算一遍——换入换出集合、队列溢出、预期损失、校准——而不是把线挪到队列刚好装得下为止。

questions.q_en: What does granted-loan-only data limit in Credit Policy Desk?
questions.q_zh: “分数不是策略。”只有已授信样本时，会受到什么限制？

en.text: It means the evidence can only describe loans that were granted: the archive contains no rejected applicants, so the backtest cannot identify what a policy would do to the full acceptance population.

The page scopes every claim to match — an offline historical backtest, not causal impact, not live or production decisioning, not regulatory validation, not real-world fairness evidence. The assumptions that fill the gaps are disclosed, LGD's flat 45% first among them.

zh.text: 意味着证据只能说明「已放款的贷款表现如何」：档案里没有被拒的申请人，所以回测无法识别一条策略对完整受理人群的效果。
页面把每条声明的范围都限定在这一点上——离线历史回测，不是因果影响，不是在线或生产决策，不是监管验证，也不是真实世界的公平性证据。用来补位的假设全部公开，头一条就是 LGD 固定 45%。

questions.q_en: What is the Analytics Tandem page?
questions.q_zh: Analytics Tandem 这个旧入口现在保留来做什么？

en.text: It is a legacy compatibility entry, kept so old links keep resolving: one qualitative case study pairing an e-commerce decision dashboard (Tableau) with a bilingual interactive risk demo (Streamlit).

Its rebuilt successor is Credit Policy Desk — the risk half redone with real granting data, contracts, and a recorded decision. The old page deliberately stays qualitative and claims no performance numbers.

zh.text: 这是一个旧版兼容入口，留着是为了让旧链接还能打开：一个定性组合案例，把电商决策仪表盘（Tableau）和双语交互式风险演示（Streamlit）放在一起。
重建后的继任项目是“分数不是策略。”——风险这一半用真实授信数据、契约和留档的人工决策重做了一遍。旧页面则有意停在定性层面，不引用任何性能数字。

contains: rebuilt successor is Credit Policy Desk

questions.q_en: What kinds of analysis did Analytics Tandem combine?
questions.q_zh: Analytics Tandem 原来把哪两类分析放在一起？

en.text: Two kinds: BI exploration — e-commerce funnel, RFM, and segmentation views — and model interaction, a deployed bilingual Streamlit demo where synthetic cases run through predict_proba to an approve-or-block outcome.
Both remain public inspection surfaces (the source repository is private and is not used as evidence), and the risk-interaction half has since been rebuilt with real evidence as Credit Policy Desk.

zh.text: 两类：一类是 BI 探索——电商漏斗、RFM 和客户分群视图；另一类是模型交互——部署好的双语 Streamlit 演示，用合成案例经 predict_proba 得到批准或拦截的结果。
两者仍是公开检查界面（源码仓库为私有，不作为证据使用）；风险交互这一半，后来在“分数不是策略。”里用真实证据重建了。

questions.q_en: What results should I not infer from Analytics Tandem?
questions.q_zh: Analytics Tandem 这个旧案例明确不主张哪些效果？

en.text: All of the quantitative ones, explicitly: the page makes no dataset-size, funnel-rate, segment-size, class-balance, validation, or model-performance claim.

The model interaction is a demonstration on synthetic inputs, not production risk approval or verified predictive performance — and the inherited dashboards are prior work, not evidence for the rebuilt analytics projects. On this site, a page without receipts says so.

zh.text: 所有量化结论都明确不主张：本页不声明数据集规模、漏斗比率、分群规模、类别平衡、验证结果或模型性能。
模型交互是用合成输入做的演示，不代表生产风险审批，也不代表已验证的预测性能；继承的仪表盘只是既往成果，不构成重建后分析项目的证据。在这个站上，拿不出收据的页面会自己说清楚。
